title: App always JUMP BACK to Today. Quite frustrating.
body:
Issues occur when a user:

1. Open a future date in Google Calendar (e.g., planning a trip).

2. Switch to another app.

3. Return to Google Calendar.

I expected a calendar to stay on the last viewed date.

But the app jumps back to Today, forcing me to find the future date again. 

Some people may like this but i am sure some people find the jump back very frustrating. 

At least, in setting, the option for a user to choose whether to enable jump-back would be very helpful.
